# Help, and what each kind of mistake gets.
@session Q2TEST
< de Q1BBS>
>
< de Q1BBS>
> ?
< B          Bye: disconnect.
< H or ?     This help.
< L          List messages; L n lists from number n up, L n-m from n to m.
< LM         List messages to you.
< LB, LP     List bulletins, or personal messages.
< L< call    List messages from call.  L> call: to call.
< R n        Read message n.  R n m ... reads several.
< S call     Send a personal message (SP too); SB area for a bulletin,
<            ST for NTS traffic.  Add @bbs for one elsewhere, $bid for an ID.
< K n        Kill message n.
< de Q1BBS>
> WOMBAT now
< Unknown command "WOMBAT".  Type H for help.
< de Q1BBS>
> L x
< "x" is not a message number
< de Q1BBS>
> L 5-2
< "5-2" is not a message number range
< de Q1BBS>
> LB
< No messages.
< de Q1BBS>
> R
< Read which message?  R n
< de Q1BBS>
> R x 7
< "x" is not a message number.
< No message 7.
< de Q1BBS>
> K
< Kill which message?  K n
< de Q1BBS>
> K x
< "x" is not a message number.
< de Q1BBS>
> S
< Send to whom?  S call, or SB area for a bulletin.
< de Q1BBS>
> S Q1-TEST
< "Q1-TEST" is not an address.
< de Q1BBS>
> S Q1TEST 123
< "123" is not a $BID of up to 12 characters.
< de Q1BBS>
> S Q1TEST $1234567890123
< "$1234567890123" is not a $BID of up to 12 characters.
< de Q1BBS>
> S Q1TEST
< Title:
> 123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901
< Titles are at most 80 characters.  Title:
> Shorter
< Enter the message.  End it with /EX or Ctrl-Z on a line of its own.
> /EX
< Message 1 saved, ID 1_Q1BBS.
< de Q1BBS>
> BYE
< 73, and thanks for calling.
< *** disconnected
